import pathlib, subprocess

repo = pathlib.Path('synthetic-code')
repo.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def git(*args):
    subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
def write(path, text):
    target = repo / path
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(text)

git('init', '-b', 'production')
git('config', 'user.name', 'Synthetic Evaluator')
git('config', 'user.email', 'evaluator@invalid')
write('src/profile/ui.ts', "export const confirmation = 'Saved'\n")
write('src/profile/service.ts', "export function saveName(name: string) { return { name } }\n")
git('add', '.')
git('commit', '-m', 'Create synthetic production baseline')
git('switch', '-c', 'test')
write('src/profile/service.ts', "export function saveName(name: string) {\n  if (!name.trim()) throw new Error('Required')\n  return { name: name.trim() }\n}\n")
git('add', '.')
git('commit', '-m', 'Add synthetic test validation')
git('switch', '-c', 'requirement')
write('src/profile/ui.ts', "export const confirmation = 'Profile saved'\n")
write('src/profile/audit.ts', "export function recordChange() { return 'recorded' }\n")
git('add', '.')
git('commit', '-m', 'Add synthetic requirement behavior')
